gate.name: binding: the carrying message must claim what the token claims
redelivery ok, stale rte refused, supersede with a new pred, close
a newer token keeps the other mirror edges
prune waits for every older token

key.note: PUBLIC test key; never a production key

verify.name: valid as bytes-equivalent string at the last valid second
iss is another key, signed by the pinned key

wire: b64url(canonical claims JSON) '.' b64url(Ed25519(key, DOMAIN || payload)), no padding
